checkpoints.description: [1/4] plan: hygiene repairs, README cold-start restructure, engine unit tests, git start

impact_assessment.why: NeuroOptic was attached to AIKit with no tests and failing hygiene and structure gates; failing work stays undeliverable and uninsurable against regressions.
impact_assessment.benefits: all four project gates pass; the engine frequency, phase and sham math gains a regression shield; README becomes cold-start ready; the project gets its own git repository with committed AIKit memory.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none - no public signature, CLI flag or file format changes; dependency: none - glfw and PyOpenGL are already declared in requirements.txt and now installed; concurrency: none - single-threaded render path untouched; state: session CSV and MATLAB loader output gain explicit utf-8 encoding, changing bytes only on non-UTF-8 locales.
impact_assessment.mitigation: keep every edit inside the gate findings; unit tests pin the pure math (Nyquist validation, phase accumulation, waveform signals, sham determinism); the full gate suite reruns after implementation before the initial commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] implementation: encoding= on 3 open() calls, typed CSV row skip, logged GPU-timer except, dead freq_std and TODO marker removed, Popen allow marker, stale requirements.txt.py deleted, README cold-start restructure, 16 unit tests added
[3/4] verification: 4/4 gates passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed
